purpose: Independent pre-execution read-only trigger review for rollback acceptance
observations: No custom triggers returned for examined tables except notifications and profiles. Notification trigger writes only transactional outbox rows. Profile role update triggers only protection/timestamp; handle trigger not invoked by role-only update. No external provider calls in returned bodies. Existing broader inventory covers seller/part/order triggers.

triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER enqueue_mobile_push_trigger AFTER INSERT ON public.notifications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enqueue_mobile_push()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_mobile_push()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.mobile_push_outbox(notification_id,profile_id,device_id)
  select new.id,new.profile_id,d.id
  from public.mobile_push_devices d
  where d.profile_id=new.profile_id
    and d.enabled
  on conflict do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER ensure_profile_handle_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF handle, display_name ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.ensure_profile_handle()
CREATE TRIGGER profiles_protect_role BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.protect_profile_role()
CREATE TRIGGER profiles_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.touch_updated_at()
